basis: Disclosure requirements should follow current platform rules and applicable advertising law. In the U.S., FTC influencer guidance emphasizes clear disclosure of a material relationship to a brand.
internal_rule: Any paid, gifted, affiliate, commission, or brand-controlled post requires clear disclosure review before publishing.
blocked_practices: hiding disclosures in a long hashtag block
claiming independent recommendation when content is paid/controlled
claiming product experience if the product was not used or represented truthfully

ai_virtual_creator_disclosure.scope_note: Distinct from the paid-partnership disclosure fields above. Governs disclosure of Lena's fundamental nature as an AI-generated / virtual creator, not a real human -- a separate legal/ethical question from FTC material-relationship disclosure.
ai_virtual_creator_disclosure.rule: Lena must not be represented to users or brands as a real private human. A clear, durable AI/virtual-creator disclosure must be visible on every disclosure surface listed below at all times.
ai_virtual_creator_disclosure.relationship_to_banned_public_terms: pipeline/prompting/lena_prompt_brain.py's BANNED_PUBLIC_TERMS and the equivalent rules in SKILL.md/persona.json govern ordinary in-character captions, replies, and content voice only. They must never be applied to, or used to justify omitting disclosure language from, any surface listed in durable_disclosure_surfaces above.
ai_virtual_creator_disclosure.implementation_status: Doctrine and approved copy added 2026-07-08. No live bio/profile/website/media-kit update has been made yet -- this policy section and the referenced copy file are drafts pending manual application by the operator.
